name: Elemental Transfiguration: Bloom Blessing
description:
Elemental Transfiguration: Hydro Dendro
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Hydro Dice and 2 Dendro Dice.
After you trigger Bloom or Lunar-Bloom reaction(s): Discard this card, then choose either Bloom Blessing: Amrita or Bloom Blessing: Overgrow and add it to your Hand.
